left.raw_text: Women 18 to 40 years of age inclusive

right.raw_text: who can give written informed consent
Available for all visits and consent to follow all procedures scheduled for the study
Agree to daily application of gel and monitoring as per Daily Monitored Adherence (DMA) method
HIV-negative as determined by a HIV rapid test at time of enrollment

left.raw_text: On a stable form of contraception

right.raw_text: at least 3 months prior to enrollment
In the absence of the use of exogenous hormone(s), have a self-reported regular menstrual cycle defined as having a minimum of 21 days and a maximum of 36 days between menses

left.raw_text: Upon pelvic/speculum examination and colposcopy at the time of enrollment, the cervix and vagina appear normal as determined by the investigator

right.raw_text: Asymptomatic for genital infections at the time of enrollment

left.raw_text: Willing to refrain from use of vaginal products or objects within 14 days prior to enrollment and for the duration of the study

right.raw_text: Willing to answer acceptability and adherence questionnaires throughout the study

left.raw_text: Willing to refrain from participation in any other research study for the duration of this study
Willing to provide adequate locator information for study retention purposes

right.raw_text: and be reachable per local standard procedures
